page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication with other cloud resources, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources and memory within a standard general-purpose profile, avoiding the premium costs associated with specialized GPU or high-RAM configurations. This resource balance makes the instance appropriate for workloads such as enterprise application hosting, web serving, distributed microservices, and general-purpose business logic processing that require substantial parallel processing capabilities without specialized hardware acceleration.
